image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a large common iguana resting in grassy vegetation. The image focuses on the mid-section and hindquarters of the lizard, showing its textured grey-green scales, a prominent row of dorsal spines (crest) running along the back, and a large circular subtympanic shield near the jaw/neck area. The head is partially visible on the left, but the face and eyes are largely out of frame or obscured by angle. The tail extends towards the right, blending into the background foliage.
